mentions.name: Ferron
mentions.description: The 3.0 major version of the Ferron web server, currently in beta, focused on being easier to debug, not just easy to set up.
mentions.problem: Ease of setup without ease of debugging is a hyperfocus trap that ends up exhausting operators.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A new major version of a web server that would be easier to debug, not just easy to setup. Because I think ease of setup without ease of debugging is a hyperfocus trap that ends up exhausting operators.

I was working a lot on it recently...

https://ferron.sh/blog/ferron-3-0-0-beta-2-released
